exposure: Maternal age (adolescent 14-20 years vs. adult >20 years)
cohort: The study included 300 singleton pregnant women aged 14-20 years (divided by trimester) and a control group of 300 singleton pregnant women older than 20 years with similar gestational ages.
finding: A high incidence of 25(OH)D deficiency was found in Turkish pregnant women, and adolescent age and low 25(OH)D levels were significant risk factors for preterm delivery and small for gestational age.
gest_age: Participants were grouped by gestational weeks (100 from each trimester) and control group had similar gestational ages.
